maintenance.reason: Alpha9.66 removes the abandoned daytime anti-import Force Discharge experiment and restores the bounded non-Agile live-control surface to Self Use outside confirmed cheap periods, confirmed-cheap Force Charge, and Min SoC-on-grid only. No grid-bias controller, fixed export trim, measured-grid feedback loop, Import Power Limit write, or Export Power Limit write exists in the live path. Deliberate/economic Force Discharge and Agile/paid-export control remain blocked. Existing commissioning, exact foxess_modbus v1.15.0, stale-data, island, emergency-stop, ownership, restoration, SOC and site-safety gates remain authoritative. Cheap-period logic is intentionally unchanged in this release so Intelligent extra-slot detection and charging can be tested independently.
